rationale: The long thesis remains structurally intact — price holds above the 9-EMA ($18.70) and VWAP ($18.39), the $18.60 invalidation is untouched, and NFXL still shows relative strength (4.39x RVOL, +4.18% gap preserved) against a -0.70% SPY.
